name: Do Son
summary: Swim the sand and walk the hill peninsula at Đồ Sơn, a bit more than 20 km from the city. This is not Hạ Long and not Cát Bà. The 12 January 2026 visitor list includes bãi tắm khu 2. A beach fee, a swim hour, and the ride minutes are Check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A half day or a night
getThere: A bit more than 20 km from the city. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: Sand, the water, and the pine hill behind the umbrellas

notice.title: Not Ha Long and not Cat Ba
notice.body: The bay and the island are other trips. This sand is the city’s peninsula. The buffalo rite uses the Đồ Sơn Nghè, not the Lê Chân temple in the center.

body: Đồ Sơn is a long-used northern resort of sand, hills, and sea. The ward is phường Vạn Hương, quận Đồ Sơn, and also phường Đồ Sơn. Both stay. Check a calm-sea month on arrival.

In 2026 the buffalo rites run from 11 to 26 September. The final is at 07:30 on 19 September, the 9th of lunar month 8, at the central stadium of phường Đồ Sơn. Fifteen buffalo reach the final. That week is the crowd, not a swim hour. Check a ticket for the final on arrival. Hòn Dấu is the smaller island off this shore. One distance is a bit under 2 km offshore. Vạn Hoa hill is nearly 2 km off the shore. Both stay. The boat fare is Check on arrival.
